# Benjamin Anderson

Electronic Engineer

[thebenjaminjanderson@gmail.com](mailto:thebenjaminjanderson@gmail.com) · London · [engiebenji.com](https://engiebenji.com) · [@engiebenji1999](https://twitter.com/engiebenji1999) · [GitHub](https://github.com/benjaminjanderson)

## Projects

### Cube

A handheld device comprising six OLED screens, one for each face of a cube. This project required the design of circuits for battery management and voltage regulation, 3D modelling of the frame, and efficient C code to run six screens and a six-DOF sensor from a single ESP32.

`KiCad` · `FreeCAD` · `Git` · `Blender`

[Project page](/projects/cube/)

### Orthodox

A unique ortholinear keyboard. This project required rapid prototyping of custom keycaps using parametric designs, PCB coils around key switches to measure analogue key presses with an LDC chip, and a custom driver to allow seamless integration with computers.

`KiCad` · `FreeCAD` · `Git` · `OpenSCAD`

[Project page](/projects/orthodox/)
